_doc: Sun & Moon sealed-product contents beyond packs and promos, read by scripts/build_box_contents.py (sun_moon()). See .claude/skills/card-textures/reference/sun-moon-box-contents.md. Products are matched by set + tcgplayerId, so the ids the set builders chose for them do not matter.

etb.note: 45 basic Energy = 5 of each of the nine Sun & Moon types. The site has no Fairy Energy, so 40 (5 of each of the other eight) are dealt.

sources.quote: 40 Basic Energy cards, increased to 45 from XY to Black Bolt & White Flare
Team Up ETB: five copies of each basic Energy card (45 total); Shining Legends ETB: multiple copies of the nine Sun & Moon Series basic Energy cards
45 Energy cards (the Sun & Moon ETBs' own product text, sm2 to sm12)
45 Pokémon TCG Energy cards
